abstract: The SMPTE 2019 Annual Technical Conference and Exhibition demonstrated the powerful ways in which creative and innovative technologies enable storytelling. Held on 21–24 October at the Westin Bonaventure Hotel & Suites in downtown Los Angeles, SMPTE 2019 attendees enjoyed a remarkable four days of conference sessions, presentations by leaders across the field of motion imaging, appearances by superstars of engineering and filmmaking, and first-of-a-kind networking and training opportunities.
